To address these challenges, we proposeMPS-CLIP, a parameter-efficient framework designed to shift the retrieval paradigm from global matching to keyword-guided fine-grained alignment.

Furthermore, a Multi-Perspective Representation (MPR) module aggregates these local cues into robust multi- perspective embeddings.

In this paper, we presented MPS-CLIP, a novel parameter-efficient framework designed to bridge the granularity gap in RSITR.

By seamlessly integrating LLMs for keyword mining and SamGeo for region generation, our approach explicitly captures fine-grained local semantics and complex spatial relationships inherent in remote sensing imagery.
